interpretation.paths: Only valid fully audited observed-to-stop trajectories enter route distances, including explicitly censored caps. Invalid observed prefixes remain separate. Distances are length-sensitive and imply no behavior beyond the imposed bounds.
interpretation.controls: Tokens use observed route, actual UI action and unique audit control text, never image-local candidate IDs across images. Audit truth remains reviewer-only.
interpretation.screens: Same PNG does not establish identical full decision input or history. recordedActionInputEqual compares only saved action-stage input, questions and assets; it does not compare all native/assessment inputs. Stable observed targets and generated candidate annotations are compared separately; raw TV requires exact candidate bindings and annotations.
interpretation.reasons: Model-reported categories are self-report only, not internal cognition or verified explanations.
interpretation.choices: Facts derive from observed successful UI actions and snapshot event deltas, with before/after references. Valid actor aggregates exclude invalid prefixes; absence is not comprehension.
interpretation.limits: Three repeats are descriptive; correlated pair distances provide no significance, naturalness ranking, field-level Persona attribution or validated human match. Goal outcomes, subjective done, infrastructure and censoring remain separate.
interpretation.reuse: Existing Persona parser, audit records and routeDistance are reused. No research dependency, model or learned weight is introduced.
